t: This bronze statue of Captain James Cook stands on a stone plinth on the south side of The Mall, near Admiralty Arch. The sculptor Thomas Brock completed it in 1914, and The Royal Parks look after it. Cook was a Royal Navy officer and cartographer who led three voyages to the Pacific and Southern Oceans between 1768 and 1779. He led the first recorded European visit to the east coast of Australia and to Hawaii. Brock is best known for the Victoria Memorial in front of Buckingham Palace.
